verdict.rationale: RUN documents a few inherently batch actions: AI-powered import of all employees' hours from an existing timesheet file, payroll runs that deposit pay into each employee's account automatically, and multi-company reports. Beyond these, there is no evidence of general-purpose bulk editing or bulk actions across arbitrary records. missing for 10: a documented bulk-edit or bulk-action capability (e.g., mass updating employee records, pay rates, or deductions), bulk operations exposed programmatically or to AI agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the batch features.
